% assume array is not empty
% assume result is a list to store the output

% invariant: result contains only odd numbers originating from array
% invariant: iteration reaches an odd number in the array

recursive extract_odd_numbers(array, result) do
  if array is empty 
    return result
  else 
    if array[0] % 2 != 0 % check if first element is odd

    end if

    end if
  end if
end do
